title: Four agents, one window
description: Pick Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Gemini per terminal and mix them freely across tabs and the grid. A brand icon on every tab and grid cell shows what is running; agents are auto-detected once installed.

title: Multi-terminal management
description: Create, manage, and monitor multiple agent sessions simultaneously with a tab-based interface and drag-and-drop reordering.

title: Smart grid view
description: View up to 8 sessions simultaneously with intelligent auto-layout, and mix agents per cell. Navigate with keyboard arrows and context menus.

title: Configuration profiles
description: Save and load terminal configurations with pre-configured CLI flags, environment variables, and working directories. Profiles are agent-agnostic: Claude-only flags are stripped when launching Codex, Cursor, or Gemini.

title: Auto-updates
description: Automatic update checks on startup with background downloads and one-click installation. Never miss a release.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for power users. Command palette (F1), session history (F2), and more.

title: Agent teams panel
description: Monitor Claude Code multi-agent team sessions with real-time team structure, member details, and task tracking.
